user.title: Choose your municipality
user.description: Waste collection calendar for the municipalities served by Gruppo Hera and its local companies, such as AcegasApsAmga in Padua and Trieste.

data_description.comune: Type a few letters of the name: the list narrows as you type. It comes straight from the provider.

via.title: Choose your street
via.description: Streets of {comune}, spelled the way the provider spells them. Padua has 2,200 of them: use the search box rather than scrolling.

data_description.via: Type any part of the name, the middle included: “bernardo” is enough to find “VIA BERNARDO TREVISAN”. If your street never shows up, the provider does not serve it under that name.

civico.title: Choose your house number
civico.description: House numbers on {via}. The collection round is decided by the exact number, so the zone is worked out from it and never asked for.

data_description.civico: Type the number to jump straight to it. House numbers may carry a suffix, for example 1/A or 2/2.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the provider. Try again in a few minutes.
error.civico_sconosciuto: This house number is not among the ones the provider lists for this street. Type it in the box and pick a suggestion.
error.comune_sconosciuto: This municipality is not in the provider's list. Type a few letters of the name and pick one of the suggestions.
error.comune_senza_vie: The provider lists no streets for this municipality. Pick another one.
error.nessun_pap: This address has no kerbside collection: it is served by street containers, and the provider publishes no calendar for it. Check the house number, or try another address.
error.via_sconosciuta: This street is not in the provider's list. Type any part of the name - the middle works too, for example “bernardo” finds “VIA BERNARDO TREVISAN” - and pick one of the suggestions.
error.via_senza_civici: The provider lists no house numbers for this street. Pick another street.

abort.already_configured: This address is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the provider. Try again in a few minutes.

init.title: Options
init.description: How the calendar events are built and how far ahead to look.

data_description.eventi_con_orario: On: each event covers the put-out window the provider publishes, for example 8 PM to midnight. Off: plain all-day events.
data_description.calendari_per_frazione: Adds one calendar entity per waste type, each carrying the provider's official colour. Colours are shown by Home Assistant 2026.6 and later.
data_description.sensori_per_frazione: Adds one sensor per waste type: its state is the date of that type's next put-out, and its attributes carry the days left, the official colour and the next dates.
data_description.giorni_da_mostrare: Glass can be up to 35 days apart, so a short horizon may hide it.
